mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_sessions ( id, user_id, refresh_token_hash, expires_at, revoked_at, created_at, last_used_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{refreshTokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{revokedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{lastUsedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, refresh_token_hash, expires_at, revoked_at, created_at, last_used_at FROM user_sessions WHERE refresh_token_hash = #{refreshTokenHash} LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password_hash, u.role, u.enabled, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM user_sessions s INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.id = #{sessionId} AND s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at > #{now} AND u.enabled = TRUE LIMIT 1
